note: The Angular<->engine seam, declared once. `scripts/generate-seam.mjs` renders JsonEngine, the wasm-bindgen methods, RawInsulaireEngine and the method table in docs/wasm-api.md from this file. See "Adding a method" in docs/wasm-api.md.

doc: The string-in / string-out facade.
This is the *exact* contract the WASM bindings expose, expressed without any
dependency on `wasm-bindgen`. Structured payloads cross as JSON strings and
errors as serialised {crate::EngineErrorPayload}s; the one bulk payload, the
terrain buffer, stays a plain byte vector.
Keeping the contract here rather than in `insulaire-wasm` means the whole boundary
is covered by ordinary `cargo test`, and the WASM crate reduces to a
pass-through that cannot hide a bug.
# Why JSON strings
Snapshots are a few hundred bytes, so the parse cost is irrelevant, and a
string boundary is trivially inspectable from devtools and from tests. The
payload that *is* large never uses JSON. See `docs/wasm-api.md`.
WebAssembly bindings for the hex engine.
This crate contains **no game logic and no boundary logic**. The string
contract — JSON in, JSON out, errors as serialised `EngineErrorPayload` —
lives in [`insulaire_engine::JsonEngine`], where it is covered by ordinary
`cargo test`. Everything here is a one-line pass-through that converts
`String` errors into `JsValue`.
That split is deliberate: a bug in the boundary should be catchable without
a browser. See `docs/wasm-api.md` and
`docs/adr/ADR-0010-engine-api.md`.
The raw class exported by the generated `wasm-bindgen` glue.
Every method that can fail throws a JSON string; {@link EngineService} wraps
them so the rest of the app only ever sees {@link EngineError}.

methods.name: engine_info
doc: Build identity: name, version, target architecture, pointer width and supported schema versions.
errors: Only on serialisation failure.

methods.name: load_tile_set
doc: Parses, validates and registers a tile set. Returns a {crate::LoadOutcome}.
errors: `parse` for malformed JSON, `invalidContent` for a failing tile set.

methods.name: load_world
doc: Parses, validates and registers a world. Returns a {crate::LoadOutcome}.
errors: `parse` for malformed JSON, `invalidContent` for a failing world. The error payload carries the full validation report.

methods.name: load_project
doc: Parses, validates and registers the project manifest — the list of content files that make up the game, and the world it starts on. Returns a {crate::LoadOutcome}.
Call it after the content it lists has been loaded.
errors: `parse` for malformed JSON, `invalidContent` when it references content that is not loaded.

methods.name: load_locale
doc: Registers one locale file under a language and a namespace. Returns a {crate::LoadOutcome} whose id is `language/namespace`.
errors: `parse` when the file is not a nested object of strings, or redefines a key the language already has.

methods.name: locale
doc: Returns a {crate::LocaleView}: one language's text, gaps filled by the default language.
errors: `unknownContent` when no file was loaded for that language.

methods.name: validate_locales
doc: Compares the loaded languages against the manifest and each other. Returns a `ValidationReport`.
errors: Only on serialisation failure.

methods.name: load_title_screen
doc: Registers the title screen a client opens on. Returns a {crate::LoadOutcome}.
errors: `parse` for malformed JSON, `invalidContent` for a screen that cannot be shown — no visible `newGame` button, an asset path leaving the content root, a number out of range.

methods.name: validate_title_screen
doc: Validates a title screen *without* registering it, keys included. Returns a `ValidationReport`.
errors: `parse` for malformed JSON.

methods.name: validate_tile_set
doc: Validates a tile set **without** registering it. Returns a `ValidationReport`.
errors: `parse` for malformed JSON.

methods.name: preview_tile_render

params.name: projection
params.doc: `"isometric"` resolves the surface and the cliff; anything else the flat image.

doc: Resolves what to draw for one cell of a tile set **passed in** — the asset editor's preview, for content that is not registered yet. Returns a `ResolvedTileRender`.

`base` is the height the cell's side faces reach down to; `roll` is the cell's variant roll (`docs/adr/ADR-0026-tile-art-is-authored-and-resolved-by-level.md`). `projection` is the world's own — `"isometric"` for the surface and the cliff, anything else for the flat image (`docs/adr/ADR-0026-tile-art-is-authored-and-resolved-by-level.md`). `choiceJson` is a `PlacedTileArt` — what the cell picked by hand — resolved against the set passed in; `"{}"` rolls everything (`docs/adr/ADR-0026-tile-art-is-authored-and-resolved-by-level.md`).
errors: `parse` when either JSON is malformed, `unknownContent` when the set defines no tile with that id.

methods.name: title_screen
doc: Returns the registered `TitleScreenDefinition`.
errors: `unknownContent` when the project ships no title screen.

methods.name: reset_content
doc: Forgets every loaded tile set, world, locale and project.
Hosts call this before re-loading a whole project, so content removed in the editor stops answering for itself. A running game is unaffected.

methods.name: reset_locales
doc: Forgets every loaded language, keeping worlds, tile sets and project.
The language editor calls this before registering the files it just wrote: loading is additive and refuses a key twice, so edited text can only replace the old text once the old bundles are gone.

methods.name: validate_links
doc: Resolves every map link across the loaded worlds. Returns a `ValidationReport`.
errors: Only on serialisation failure.

methods.name: validate_world
doc: Validates a world *without* registering it — the editor's pre-export check. Returns a `ValidationReport`.
errors: `parse` for malformed JSON. An unusable world yields an invalid report, not an error.

methods.name: content_summary
doc: Returns a {crate::ContentSummary}: loaded tile sets, worlds and templates.
errors: Only on serialisation failure.

methods.name: world_view
doc: Returns a {crate::WorldView}: dimensions, tile palette and locations.
errors: `unknownContent` when the world is not registered.

methods.name: terrain_buffer
doc: Returns the packed terrain buffer as a `Uint8Array`: one palette index per cell, row-major in offset coordinates.
This is one of the three bulk transfers in the API, and the reason the renderer never calls into WASM per tile.
errors: `unknownContent` when the world is not registered.

methods.name: elevation_buffer
doc: Returns the packed elevation buffer as an `Int8Array`: one signed byte per cell, in the same layout as `terrainBuffer`.
Presentation only; the renderer uses it in isometric mode (`docs/adr/ADR-0013-isometric-projection.md`).
errors: `unknownContent` when the world is not registered.

methods.name: presence_buffer
doc: Returns the packed presence buffer as a `Uint8Array`: `1` where the map has a hex, `0` where it has a hole, in the same layout as `terrainBuffer`.
A map is a set of hexes, not a rectangle; the extent in `worldView().bounds` is only what the buffers cover (`docs/adr/ADR-0033-a-map-is-a-set-of-hexes.md`).
errors: `unknownContent` when the world is not registered.

methods.name: create_game
doc: Starts a game on a registered world. Returns the initial {crate::GameSnapshot}.
errors: `unknownContent` or `setup`.

methods.name: load_settings
doc: Registers the game's settings declaration. Returns a {crate::LoadOutcome}.
errors: `parse` for malformed JSON, `invalidContent` for a declaration that cannot be rendered — a duplicate id, a default no control accepts.

methods.name: validate_settings
doc: Validates a settings declaration *without* registering it, keys included. Returns a `ValidationReport`.
errors: `parse` for malformed JSON.

methods.name: settings
doc: Returns the registered `SettingsDefinition`.
errors: `unknownContent` when the project declares no settings.

methods.name: resolve_settings
doc: Resolves values against the declaration: defaults filled, unknown keys dropped, numbers clamped. Returns the resolved object.
errors: `parse` when the values are not a JSON object.

methods.name: load_character
doc: Parses, validates and registers a character definition. Returns a {crate::LoadOutcome}.
errors: `parse` for malformed JSON, `invalidContent` for a failing definition.

methods.name: validate_character
doc: Validates a character definition *without* registering it, keys included. Returns a `ValidationReport`.
errors: `parse` when the JSON is malformed.

methods.name: character
doc: Returns a registered {insulaire_world::CharacterDefinition}.
errors: `unknownContent` when no definition has that id.

methods.name: character_ids
doc: Returns the ids of every registered character definition.
errors: Only on serialisation failure.

methods.name: load_decoration
doc: Parses, validates and registers a decoration definition. Returns a {crate::LoadOutcome}.
errors: `parse` for malformed JSON, `invalidContent` for a failing definition.

methods.name: validate_decoration
doc: Validates a decoration definition *without* registering it. Returns a `ValidationReport`.
`cell_json` is the `TileArtGeometry` it will stand among; `""` skips `decoration.overflowsCell` alone.
errors: `parse` when either JSON is malformed.

methods.name: decoration
doc: Returns a registered {insulaire_world::DecorationDefinition}.
errors: `unknownContent` when no definition has that id.

methods.name: decoration_ids
doc: Returns the ids of every registered decoration definition.
errors: Only on serialisation failure.

methods.name: resolve_decoration
doc: Resolves a registered decoration at a moment of one of its animations. Returns a `ResolvedDecoration`.
errors: `unknownContent` when no definition has that id.

methods.name: preview_decoration
doc: Resolves a decoration definition passed in by the editor.
errors: `parse` when the JSON is malformed.

methods.name: load_object
doc: Parses, validates and registers an object definition. Returns a {crate::LoadOutcome}.
errors: `parse` for malformed JSON, `invalidContent` for a failing definition.

methods.name: validate_object
doc: Validates an object definition *without* registering it, keys included. Returns a `ValidationReport`.
errors: `parse` when the JSON is malformed.

methods.name: object
doc: Returns a registered {insulaire_world::ObjectDefinition}.
errors: `unknownContent` when no definition has that id.

methods.name: object_ids
doc: Returns the ids of every registered object definition.
errors: Only on serialisation failure.

methods.name: resolve_object
doc: Resolves a registered object's icon at a moment of its flipbook. Returns a `ResolvedObject`.
errors: `unknownContent` when no definition has that id.

methods.name: preview_object
doc: Resolves an object definition passed in by the editor.
errors: `parse` when the JSON is malformed.

methods.name: load_character_creation
doc: Parses, validates and registers a generic character-creation declaration. Character definitions must be loaded first.
errors: `parse` for malformed JSON, `invalidContent` for a declaration that cannot be shown.

methods.name: validate_character_creation
doc: Validates a character-creation declaration without registering it.
errors: `parse` when the JSON is malformed.

methods.name: character_creation
doc: Returns the registered `CharacterCreationDefinition`.
errors: `unknownContent` when the project declares none.

methods.name: resolve_character_creation
doc: Resolves submitted creation choices and characteristics without interpreting any author-owned id.
errors: `parse` when either values payload is not JSON, `unknownContent` when no declaration is loaded.

methods.name: preview_character_creation
doc: Resolves a creation definition passed in by the editor.
errors: `parse` when any of the three arguments is not JSON.

methods.name: preview_character
doc: Resolves a definition **passed in** against a customisation, at a moment of an animation — the editor's preview, for content that is not registered yet. Returns a {insulaire_world::ResolvedCharacter}.
`animation` of `undefined` — or an id the definition does not declare — is the rest pose. `time_ms` counts from the start of the animation.
errors: `parse` when either argument is not JSON.

methods.name: resolve_character
doc: Resolves a definition against a customisation such as `{"hairColor":"#f2c14e"}`, at a moment of an animation. Returns a {insulaire_world::ResolvedCharacter}.
errors: `parse` when the values are not JSON, `unknownContent` when no definition has that id.

methods.name: resolve_character_role
doc: Resolves the animation assigned to a gameplay role such as `idle` or `moveNorthWest`. Exact movement directions fall back to the authored left/right roles when absent.
errors: `parse` for an unknown role or malformed values, `unknownContent` when no definition has that id.

methods.name: snapshot
doc: Returns the current {crate::GameSnapshot}.
errors: `noGame` when nothing is running.

methods.name: dispatch
doc: Applies a command such as `{"type":"moveTo","to":[3,4]}` or `{"type":"wait"}`. Returns a {crate::CommandResult}.
An *illegal* command is not an error: it comes back with `accepted: false` and a `rejection`.
errors: `parse` for an unknown command shape, `noGame` when nothing is running.

methods.name: end_game
doc: Discards the running game. Content stays loaded.

methods.name: has_game
doc: `true` when a game is in progress.
